resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Tiverton register gives 1964 as the build year. The Quaker Hill register says the Portsmouth tower was re-erected on High School Hill after its 1963 removal but gives no date. The 1963 notice authorized relocation to that site. Read together, 1964 probably marks the re-erection, but no source says so.

notes_for_editor: Only the register and one newspaper notice give Tiverton-specific facts. The 2005 demolition date comes from one source and is given as approximate. The link between the 1963 relocation notice and the Tiverton tower is inferred from the Quaker Hill register and the dates, not stated by a source. A Facebook group post titled North Brayton Road Fire Tower appeared in search results but could not be fetched; its snippet mentions a demolition for school tennis courts, which is unverified and not used. The Tiverton Historical Society page had no tower mention. No photos added; the existing FFLOS photo is already in the record.
